title: Sugar Factories Control Second Amendment Ordinance 2020

sections.shortTitle: Sugar Factories Control Second Amendment Ordinance 2020
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XIV OF 2020
ORDINANCE XIV OF 2020
SUGAR FACTORIES (CONTROL)
(SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2020
An Ordinance to amend the Sugar Factories
(Control) Act, 1950
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
14th October, 2020]
No.
Legis: 13-86/2001(P-I), dated 14.10.2020.---The following Ordinance promulgated by Governor of the Punjab is
hereby published for general information:-
It
is necessary to amend the Sugar Factories (Control) Act, 1950 (XXII of 1950) to
modify the provisions relating to crushing of the Cane.
Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab is not in session and Governor of the Punjab is
satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate
action.
In
exercise of the powers conferred under clause (1) of Article 128 of
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Ordinance may be cited as the Sugar Factories (Control) (Second Amendment)
Ordinance, 2020.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

ORDINANCE XIV OF 2020
SUGAR FACTORIES (CONTROL)
(SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2020
An Ordinance to amend the Sugar Factories
(Control) Act, 1950
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
14th October, 2020]
No.
Legis: 13-86/2001(P-I), dated 14.10.2020.---The following Ordinance promulgated by Governor of the Punjab is
hereby published for general information:-
It
is necessary to amend the Sugar Factories (Control) Act, 1950 (XXII of 1950) to
modify the provisions relating to crushing of the Cane.
Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab is not in session and Governor of the Punjab is
satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate
action.
In
exercise of the powers conferred under clause (1) of Article 128 of
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:
2. Substitution
of section 8 of Act XXII of 1950.---In
the Sugar Factories (Control) Act, 1950 (XXII of 1950), for brevity referred to
as the Act, for section 8, the following shall be substituted:
"8.
Crushing.---The occupier of a factory shall start crushing of Cane not
later than a date specified by the Government.".
